The 1953–54 season was '''[[Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]''''s [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|51st season]] in existence and the club's 23rd consecutive season in the top flight of Spanish football.

Real Madrid won their 3rd Primera División title after a gap of [[1933–34 Madrid FC season|21 years]].

==Summary==
The club won its third league title over defending champion [[FC Barcelona]] after 21 years aimed by several arrivals such as Di Stefano from [[Millonarios Fútbol Club]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.co/futbol/colombia/nota/_/id/6899891/alfredo-distefano-la-leyenda-que-hizo-enorme-a-millonarios|publisher=ESPN|title=Alfredo Di Stéfano La Leyenda que hizo enorme a Millonarios|language=es}}</ref> (included a transfer battle with [[FC Barcelona|CF Barcelona]])<ref>{{cite web|url=https://elpais.com/deportes/2017/08/06/actualidad/1502042406_757005.html|work=El País|title=How Real Madrid Snatched Di Stefano From Barcelona}}</ref> and 20-yrs-old winger from Racing Santander [[Francisco Gento]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2016/10/paco-gento-honorary-president-of-real-madrid|title=Paco Gento, Honorary President of Real Madrid|date=23 October 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/teams/te1545/real-madrid/squad/ |title=Real Madrid » Squad 1987/1988 |publisher=worldfootball.net |access-date=11 June 2019}}</ref> On 1 August 1953 Spanish Federation banned the foreign players transfers to [[La Liga]] clubs and not lifting the measure until 1956 with the exception of [[oriundo]] players, meaning athletes who were born abroad but had Spanish ancestors as [[Alfredo Di Stéfano]] had.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2020/05/26/reportajes/1590459438_017479.html|publisher=as.com|title=A League of Foreigners|language=es|author=Ignacio Camacho|access-date=1 July 2020}}</ref> Also, newcomer striker [[Alfredo Di Stéfano]] got the [[Pichichi trophy]] of league topscorer with 27 goals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2016/03/28/mas_futbol/1459142039_378266.html|title=Di Stefano makes a goal to Saso|publisher=as.com|access-date=2 July 2020}}</ref> In June, the squad reached [[1954 Copa del Generalísimo]] semi-finals being defeated by [[FC Barcelona]]. Real played without Di Stéfano, as the Copa del Generalísimo only allowed Spanish players to enter at the time.
